--Loans and Grants
Loans and grants are available only in the existing area in the 4th year. This assistance will also be available in the expanded area in the 5th and 6th years. There are 172 substandard units in the expanded area; 99 units are estimated to be improved within the three years, leaving 73 units after the 6th year.
If this area receives CHRA designation, CDBG subsidized loans will also be available for home purchase and refinancing with rehabilitation.
Interim Rehab. Assistance Program
This new project is proposed for the 5th and 6th years to provide funding for loans to repair hazards or emergency conditions. Loans or deferred loans will be available up to $5,000; no grants would be available. Applicants must live in the Central or Alum Rock Planning Area and have low incomes (2 person family - $7,690 year gross income; 4 person family - $9,950). Loans would be only to repair hazards that will immediately endanger the health or safety of the occupant.
